author: Andrej Karpathy
text:
Pomodoro technique 
https://
en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pomodoro_
Technique
… simple idea: break up time/work into discrete committed chunks of 25min, has some nice benefits wrt psychology and analysis.

topReplies.author: Aleksa Gordić (水平问题)
topReplies.text:
The only time I found it useful is when I was doing something that I don't enjoy that much. 

But that may be only me I dunno.

topReplies.author: ʞɔɐɾ ɯɐ ı
topReplies.text: I have a 30 min hour glass for this purpose. When I turn it I’m not allowed to take any kinda of break until the sand is out. Usualy@by that time I’m lost in the problem and just keep going

topReplies.author: Dusty Greene
topReplies.text: Will this still work if mine is just a regular POME and not a pomodoro? 😆😉

topReplies.author: Jack
topReplies.text:
Yes! Life changer for me.

First heard of it on Dr Barbara Oakley course on "Learning how to learn" about 10 years ago.

Still my default way to organize study and work sessions.

For timing and statistics I use 
https://
pomodoro-tracker.com

topReplies.author: carlos
topReplies.text: Personally, I think it is good when you are in a leader / management role and need to deal with reports, Pomodoro helps you remember that you actually have a team. For the head-down moments, "he's-wired", not so much.

topReplies.author: Michael Rigoni
topReplies.text:
@karpathy
 tell us more about your perspective on the psychological and analytical benefits

topReplies.author: Vikram Shukla
topReplies.text: In high school and college I could sit down for hours, laser focused mainly due to competition. As I grow older and more distracted (self-inflicted and otherwise), I have found that 30 mins is sweet spot for me, occasionally can push it to 45 mins.

topReplies.author: Marin Vlastelica 🤖🎸
topReplies.text: There seems to be something unnatural about breaking deep focus especially when working on a big problem. I think unfortunately some problems require continuous > 25 min commitment to be solved efficiently, ie are not breakable in 25 min chunks.
